title: Former Pentagon UFO Investigator Says Alien Implants Have Their Own Metabolism, Can Dodge Surgeons' Scalpels

content:
Former Pentagon UFO investigator Luis Elizondo has made some pretty wild claims over the years about aliens, UFOs and what the U.S. government supposedly knows about them. His latest comments, however, might be his strangest yet.

During an interview with Chris Cuomo this week, Elizondo claimed mysterious objects allegedly removed from people who reported UFO encounters appeared to have their own metabolism.

But wait, there’s more.

He also claimed some of these alien implants actually moved around inside people’s bodies when surgeons attempted to remove them.

Former Pentagon UFO Investigator Describes Bizarre Alien Implants

Luis Elizondo, who worked with the Pentagon’s Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP), discussed these new claims following the government’s latest UFO file dump.

According to Elizondo, military and intelligence personnel who reported UFO encounters later had to have mysterious implants surgically removed from their bodies.

“When that foreign object was removed, it was studied under a microscope, and it really had some very perplexing properties,” he told Chris Cuomo. “First of all, it seemed to have its own metabolism.”

Elizondo said the objects seemed to have their own energy source, unlike regular human tissue removed during surgery. He also described what appeared to be a technological device surrounded by biological tissue, perhaps to prevent the body’s immune system from rejecting it.

Then things got even weirder.

Elizondo claimed that when surgeons attempted to remove certain objects, they appeared to move beneath the skin to avoid the scalpel.

Elizondo Also Discussed The Skinwalker Ranch And Other UFO Claims

Luis Elizondo also discussed the Pentagon’s recently released UFO files, including reports involving Utah’s infamous Skinwalker Ranch. He claimed government investigators examined two additional ranches and that certain federal organizations remain interested in similar locations.

Of course, this isn’t the first time Elizondo has discussed alleged alien implants. In 2024, we reported on his previous claims involving mysterious objects removed from humans. He has also testified before Congress about UFOs.

Former Weapons Designer Makes More Outlandish Claims

Meanwhile, as Luis Elizondo made his unusual comments, former military weapons designer Gary Moshier was making extraordinary claims of his own.

According to the Daily Star, Moshier believes extraterrestrials are deliberately intimidating the U.S. military by demonstrating superior technology.

“They challenge our Navy fighters, harass them, shadow them and get them into engagements,” Moshier claimed. “So, they’re taunting us.”

He also believes aliens have a much bigger objective: eventually colonizing Earth.

“My opinion is that we’re being visited by an alien race whose main agenda is repopulation of planet Earth,” he said.

Of course, neither man’s claims establish that extraterrestrials have actually visited Earth, implanted objects inside humans, or are preparing to colonize the planet. Then again, no one has definitively proven them wrong yet either, have they?
